name: Bubble Level
description: Turn your phone into a spirit level. Check whether any surface is flat, plumb or at an exact angle, with a live degree readout.
longDescription: A bubble level that lives in your browser. It reads the device accelerometer to show tilt in degrees, with horizontal, plumb and bull's-eye modes plus one-tap calibration on a surface you trust.
pricingDetails: Completely free. No ads, no account.
features: One-tap calibration for phone and case offset
useCases: Hanging a shelf or picture frame straight
Levelling a table, tripod or appliance
